text:
deploy-bot: Preflight failed for release 2026.03.21-rc3 — SECRET_VISIBILITY_MISMATCH detected between staging and prod for service inference-ingester. Key: keystore.s3_prefix
alice: Ugh. Can someone paste the failing check output?
ben: From deploybot: `mismatches: staging: s3://redwood-keystore/inference/ingester/  prod: s3://redwood-keystore/inference/ingester` — trailing slash only in staging.
carol: That explains it. SOPS/KMS wraps in staging added the slash during backfill last week.
alice: Does this affect runtime lookup? We saw 502s in canary earlier.
ben: Yes, the runtime uses exact key path for env fetch. If prod doesn't have trailing slash, the keystore lookup failed -> fallback to empty creds -> auth error -> 502.
dave: Can we patch runtime to normalize keys? That's riskier mid-window.
emma: Ops suggestion: pause rollout, pin traffic to v2.14.1, run a quick keystore normalization job to create alias with trailing slash in prod.
alice: Agree. What's the cost of rollback vs hotfix?
carol: Rollback will be fast (traffic back to v2.14.0) but loses other fixes in this release. Hotfix is small (insertion of alias key) and reversible.
ben: We should also update release notes: note the keystore normalization quirk and add a follow-up ticket to canonicalize key formatting in the runtime.
emma: I'll run the backfill script now: `./scripts/keystore-copy --from prod --normalize-trailing-slash --prefix inference/ingester` — should take ~2m.
alice: @emma keep us posted. Holding rollout during backfill and QA. If backfill fails, we rollback.
deploy-bot: Rollout paused by alice (manual hold). Reason: SECRET_VISIBILITY_MISMATCH. Auto-rollback window set to 30m.
emma: Backfill succeeded. Verified in prod:
```
kubectl get secret inference-ingester -n prod -o jsonpath='{.data.keystore_path}' | base64 --decode
s3://redwood-keystore/inference/ingester/
```
carol: QA smoke looks good on canary. No 502s after retry.
ben: OK to resume canary traffic +10% for 15m then proceed.
alice: Resuming. Will update release notes and pin changelog: "Fixed keystore keyslash parity causing transient canary failures."
emma: Logged follow-up: #TICKET-4532 "Canonicalize keystore keys and make lookup tolerant of trailing slash". Assigning to infra.
alice: Thanks all. Marking thread resolved and noting in the release window summary.
